Keep SOURCE_INDEX as the only registration of external models. A search hit goes
to a task report until inspected. Record upstream commit/tree, license, author
control, required inputs and the exact prerequisite or question addressed.
Separate facts read from inferences and computed results. Never claim an author
result reproduced after reading a README. A missing license is not permission to
copy. Upstream updates create review proposals, never advance accepted pins.
Run `python tools/external_sources.py validate` and the registry checker. Frozen
contracts and runtime budgets precede execution of any external implementation.
